scope: Saved Ahrefs Free Keyword Generator observations; no new provider requests.

definitions.range: The displayed inequality is retained verbatim. No midpoint, upper bound, or exact count is inferred.
definitions.numeric: A numeric value actually displayed by Ahrefs; still a provider estimate.
definitions.no_data: Empty saved result rows with an explicit provider notice. This is unavailable data, not zero demand.
definitions.incomplete_capture: Empty saved result rows without a notice. No conclusion about provider coverage or demand.
definitions.volume_unavailable: A returned row has no parseable volume; raw value retained.
definitions.updated: Verbatim keyword-card/data freshness label; not the search-volume measurement period.
definitions.date: Date the saved provider observation was collected, not the card update date or averaging window.
definitions.country: Selected Ahrefs country code preserved from the capture; not the language or all users of that language.
definitions.zero: Only an actually returned numeric 0 would be numeric zero. Missing rows or metrics are never converted to 0.

volume_context.engine: Google-context Ahrefs estimates; never Baidu or Yandex measurements.
volume_context.documented_averaging: Ahrefs documents country-level search volume as a 12-month average.
volume_context.exact_month_window: Not exposed in the saved Free Keyword Generator UI captures.
volume_context.mainland_china: Not available in the examined country dropdown. Singapore captures, if present, are a Google-market proxy for zh-CN wording and are not mainland China or Baidu demand.
volume_context.taiwan: Only country tw captures can be attributed to the selected Taiwan market; Hong Kong or worldwide metadata is not substituted.
volume_context.russia: Country ru captures remain Google-context estimates; not Yandex volumes.
